2) Thu Sep 18 — 2:00–3:30pm
3) Fri Sep 19 — 9:00–10:30am

Please let me know which slot works best or share a few windows that fit your team. If helpful, Rajesh can forward any current perf logs or infra diagrams in advance.

- 20m current infra + dataset characteristics (CloudVista)
- 30–45m model serving architecture & perf tests (Redwood demo + benchmarks)
- 10–15m security/compliance & deployment modes (VPC/on-prem)

I’ll coordinate internal attendees once we lock a time — I plan to include our solutions engineer (Rishi) and the TDX owner (Marissa).
